card.text: HD 80606 b was found in 2001 as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 80606 b"
sources.quote: HD 80606 b is an eccentric hot Jupiter 217 light-years from the Sun in the constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HD 80606. Its orbit and size follow Pearson et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: HD 80606 b was discovered orbiting the star HD 80606 in April 2001 by a team led by Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz.
